sections.title: The service
paragraphs: These terms apply to access to Alex Orr's current personal All Seeing Eye installation. It is a self-hosted research tool: public observations appear on a globe and map, and question-led research produces saved assessments with selected evidence, provenance and uncertainty.

Access requires the operator's permission. These access rules do not grant a software redistribution licence, a third-party data licence, paid support or an availability guarantee. Any future commercial service requires its own agreed terms.

sections.title: Who may use it
paragraphs: You must be 18 or over, and you may use the installation only for professional or research purposes.
Use it only for lawful, proportionate research and respect other people's privacy, intellectual property and source-specific conditions. The Acceptable Use Policy forms part of these terms.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: Your account is for you alone. Keep your password and sign-in factors to yourself, and tell the operator promptly at alexorr@yahoo.co.uk if you think someone else has used your account.
Do not upload material you lack authority to use or send to the selected providers. Do not submit sensitive personal information without a separately assessed lawful condition and safeguards.
The operator may restrict access to investigate misuse or protect the service, while handling personal-data requests through the published procedure.

sections.title: AI output
paragraphs: AI outputs and source labels are research aids and can be wrong; check the evidence before relying on or sharing them.
The installation must not be used to make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on people.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: No availability guarantee is given. Public sources and AI providers can be unavailable, change or withdraw data without notice, and the installation may be paused for maintenance or to protect the service.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: Nothing here removes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

paragraphs.pending: Any limitation of the operator's liability, and its extent, needs the operator's decision and legal review.
Governing law and courts. KAN-188 proposes England and Wales, while the privacy notice applies EU GDPR and Finnish law to this installation. The operator must choose, with legal review.

sections.title: How changes are notified
paragraphs: When these terms or the Acceptable Use Policy change, the version date on this page changes. Signed-in accounts are then asked to review and accept the new version on their next visit before continuing, and each acceptance is recorded with its version and time.
Report misuse or access concerns to alexorr@yahoo.co.uk.
